headline: Gate E chemical energy coupling (Option B, specified thioester carrier — NOT acyl-phosphate / microkinetic): verdict=qualified. Under a declining geochemical drive (the gradient dipping) and a full free-energy ledger that CLOSES in both arms (max|budget_residual| 9e-19, no hidden inflow), the thioester carrier does useful work THROUGH the dip (0.0302) where the matched gradient-only control starves (0.0060) - so the carrier pays on DIP-PERSISTENCE (persistence_pays=True). On TOTAL useful work, carrier 0.2564 vs gradient-only 0.2820 (throughput_pays=False): the merged carrier gates activation at the bond and does not capture the above-bond surplus, so it TIME-SHIFTS work into the dip rather than netting more, and hydrolysis is a real cost. On the cost/benefit window, the carrier does NOT beat gradient-only on total useful work at any tested leak rate (including zero hydrolysis) - it banks/time-shifts and leaves some carrier unused at run end, so the benefit is strictly dip-persistence, not total throughput. So qualified = pays on persistence-through-the-dip with a closed ledger, not a clean net-positive-total win; the carrier buys gradient-dip resilience, not raw throughput - the same persistence-not-throughput motif as the pore (Gate B) and the membrane (Gate C). Acyl-phosphate / microkinetic resolution (Option A) is the follow-on og-35a. Metabolism = sustained A1 network, NOT autocatalytic (A2 refuted).
